name: SerializedLob
summary: A graph of objects saved into a single field as one serialised value.

roles.name: SerializedLob
roles.summary: A type stored whole, in one column, rather than mapped. It suits a structure the database never has to query into and whose shape changes often. The cost is deferred rather than avoided: nothing can query inside it, and the day the format changes every stored value must still be readable.
